G3956.forms: πᾶς, πᾶσα, πᾶν, genitive, παντός, πάσης, παντός
G3956.root: including all the forms of declension; apparently a primary word
G3956.kjv: all (manner of, means), alway(-s), any (one), X daily, + ever, every (one, way), as many as, + no(-thing), X thoroughly, whatsoever, whole, whosoever
senses: with subst. anarth., all, every, of every kind: [[r:MAT.3.10|Mat 3:10 4:23]], [[r:MRK.9.49|Mrk 9:49]], [[r:LUK.4.37|Luk 4:37]], [[r:JHN.2.1|Jhn 2:1]]o, [[r:ACT.27.20|Act 27:20]], [[r:ROM.7.8|Rom 7:8]], [[r:REV.18.17|Rev 18:17]], al. mult.; pl., all, [[r:ACT.22.15|Act 22:15]], [[r:ROM.5.12|Rom 5:12]], [[r:HEB.1.6|Heb 1:6]], al.; of the highest degree, π. ἐξουσία (προθυμία, χαρά), [[r:MAT.28.18|Mat 28:18]], [[r:ACT.17.11|Act 17:11]], [[r:PHP.2.29|Phi 2:29]], al.; also the whole (though in this sense more frequently with art.), [[r:MAT.2.3|Mat 2:3]], [[r:ACT.2.36|Act 2:36]], [[r:ROM.11.26|Rom 11:26]].

C. art. (before the art., after the noun, or, denoting totality, between the art. and noun), all, whole: [[r:MAT.8.32|Mat 8:32 13:2]], [[r:MRK.5.33|Mrk 5:33]], [[r:LUK.1.10|Luk 1:10]], [[r:ACT.7.14|Act 7:14]], [[r:ROM.3.19|Rom 3:19]], [[r:GAL.5.14|Gal 5:14]], [[r:EPH.4.16|Eph 4:16]], al.; pl., [[r:MAT.2.4|Mat 2:4]], [[r:MRK.4.13|Mrk 4:13]], [[r:ROM.1.5|Rom 1:5]], al.

masc. and fem., every one: [[r:MRK.9.49|Mrk 9:49]], [[r:LUK.16.16|Luk 16:16]], [[r:HEB.2.9|Heb 2:9]]; before rel. pron., [[r:MAT.7.24|Mat 7:24]], [[r:ACT.2.21|Act 2:21]], [[r:GAL.3.10|Gal 3:10]], al.; with ptcp. (anarth.), [[r:MAT.13.19|Mat 13:19]], [[r:LUK.11.4|Luk 11:4]]; with ptcp. (with art.), [[r:MAT.5.22|Mat 5:22]], [[r:MRK.7.8|Mrk 7:8]], [[r:LUK.6.47|Luk 6:47]], [[r:JHN.3.8|Jhn 3:8]], [[r:ROM.1.16|Rom 1:16]], al.; pl., πάντες, absol., all, all men, [[r:MAT.10.22|Mat 10:22]], [[r:MRK.13.13|Mrk 13:13]], [[r:LUK.20.38|Luk 20:38]], [[r:JHN.1.7|Jhn 1:7 3:26]], [[r:1CO.8.1|1Co 8:1]], al.; οἱ π. (collectively, as a definite whole), [[r:ROM.11.32|Rom 11:32]], [[r:1CO.1.17|1Co 1:17]], [[r:EPH.4.13|Eph 4:13]], al.; π. οἱ (ὅσοι), [[r:MAT.4.24|Mat 4:24]], [[r:MRK.1.32|Mrk 1:32]], [[r:LUK.4.40|Luk 4:40]], al.

sing., πᾶν, everything, all: πᾶν τό, with ptcp., [[r:1CO.10.25|1Co 10:25, 27]], [[r:EPH.5.13|Eph 5:13]], [[r:1JN.2.16|1Jn 2:16 5:4]] (sc. ὄν); πᾶν ὅ, [[r:JHN.17.2|Jhn 17:2]], [[r:ROM.14.23|Rom 14:23]]; collectively, of persons (Westc., in l.), [[r:JHN.6.37|Jhn 6:37, 39]]; with prep., in adverbial phrases, διὰ παντός, always, [[r:MAT.18.10|Mat 18:10]], al.; ἐν παντί, in everything, in every way, [[r:2CO.4.8|2Co 4:8]], [[r:PHP.4.6|Phi 4:6]], al.;

pl., πάτνα, all things: absol., [[r:JHN.1.3|Jhn 1:3]], [[r:1CO.2.10|1Co 2:10]], [[r:HEB.2.8|Heb 2:8]], al.; of certain specified things, [[r:MRK.4.34|Mrk 4:34]], [[r:LUK.1.3|Luk 1:3]], [[r:ROM.8.28|Rom 8:28]], [[r:1TH.5.21|1Th 5:21]], al.; accusative, πάντα, adverbially, wholly, in all things, in all respects, [[r:ACT.20.35|Act 20:35]], [[r:1CO.9.25|1Co 9:25]], al.; with art., τὰ π., all things (a totality, as distinct from anarth. πάντα, all things severally; cf. Westc, Eph., 186f.), absol.: [[r:ROM.11.36|Rom 11:36]], [[r:1CO.8.6|1Co 8:6]], [[r:EPH.3.9|Eph 3:9]], [[r:HEB.1.3|Heb 1:3]], al.; relatively, [[r:MRK.4.11|Mrk 4:11]], [[r:ACT.17.25|Act 17:25]], [[r:ROM.8.32|Rom 8:32]], al.; πάντα, with ptcp., [[r:MAT.18.31|Mat 18:31]], al.; πάντα ταῦτα (ταῦτα π.), [[r:MAT.6.32|Mat 6:32, 33]], al.; πάντα, with prep, in adverbial phrases, πρὸ πάντων, above all things, [[r:JAS.5.12|Jas 5:12]], [[r:1PE.4.8|1Pe 4:8]]; ἐν π́, in all things, in all ways, [[r:1TI.3.11|1Ti 3:11]], [[r:1PE.4.11|1Pe 4:11]], al.; κατὰ πάντα, in all respects, [[r:ACT.17.22|Act 17:22]], al.
C. neg., πᾶς οὐ (μή) = οὐδείς, see: οὐ and μή, and cf. M, Pr., 245f. (AS)

G3933.strongs: a maiden; by implication, an unmarried daughter

G3992.strongs: to dispatch (from the subjective view or point of departure, whereas (as a stronger form of) refers rather to the objective point or terminus ad quem, and denotes properly, the orderly motion involved), especially on a temporary errand; also to transmit, bestow, or wield
senses: of persons: with accusative, absol., [[r:MAT.22.7|Mat 22:7]], [[r:LUK.7.19|Luk 7:19]], [[r:JHN.1.22|Jhn 1:22]], [[r:2CO.9.3|2Co 9:3]], al.; ptcp. before verb., [[r:MAT.14.10|Mat 14:10]], [[r:ACT.19.31|Act 19:31]], al.; ptcp. before διά (= Heb. יָד;, [[r:1KI.16.20|1Ki 16:20]], al.), [[r:MAT.11.2|Mat 11:2]] (cf. [[r:REV.1.1|Rev 1:1]]); of teachers sent by God, [[r:JHN.1.33|Jhn 1:33 4:34]], [[r:ROM.8.3|Rom 8:3]], al.; with accusative and dative, [[r:1CO.4.17|1Co 4:17]], [[r:PHP.2.19|Php 2:19]]; before πρός, with accusative, [[r:LUK.4.26|Luk 4:26]], [[r:JHN.16.7|Jhn 16:7]], al.; before λέγων (cf. Heb. אָמַר שָׁלַח [[r:GEN.38.25|Gen 38:25]], al.), [[r:LUK.7.6|Luk 7:6, 19]]; before εἰς, with accusative loc., [[r:MAT.2.8|Mat 2:8]], [[r:LUK.15.15|Luk 15:15]], al.; before εἰς (of purpose), [[r:EPH.6.22|Eph 6:22]], [[r:COL.4.8|Col 4:8]], [[r:1PE.2.14|1Pe 2:14]]; with inf., [[r:JHN.1.33|Jhn 1:33]], [[r:1CO.16.3|1Co 16:3]], [[r:REV.22.16|Rev 22:16]];

of things : [[r:REV.11.10|Rev 11:10]]; before εἰς, [[r:REV.1.11|Rev 1:11]]; id., of purpose, [[r:ACT.11.29|Act 11:29]], [[r:PHP.4.16|Php 4:16]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:2TH.2.11|2Th 2:11]]; π. τ. δρέπανον σου (cf. εξαποστείλατε δρέπανα = מַגָּל שָׁלַח, [[r:JOL.3.13|Jol 3:13]]), [[r:REV.14.15|Rev 14:15, 18]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἐκ-, μετα-, προ-, συν-πέμπω) SYN.: ἀποστέλλω, q.v (AS)

G3962.strongs: a "father" (literally or figuratively, near or more remote)
senses: of the male parent: [[r:MAT.2.22|Mat 2:22]], [[r:LUK.1.17|Luk 1:17]], [[r:JHN.4.53|Jhn 4:53]]; anarth., [[r:HEB.12.7|Heb 12:7]] (M, Pr., 82 f.); pl., of both parents (cl.), [[r:HEB.11.23|Heb 11:23]]; οἱ π. τ. σαρκός, [[r:HEB.12.9|Heb 12:9]];

of a forefather or ancestor (in cl. usually in pl.; Hom., al.): [[r:MAT.3.9|Mat 3:9]], [[r:LUK.1.73|Luk 1:73]], [[r:JHN.8.39|Jhn 8:39]], al.; pl., [[r:MAT.23.30|Mat 23:30, 32]] [[r:LUK.6.23|Luk 6:23, 26]] [[r:JHN.4.20|Jhn 4:20]], [[r:1CO.10.1|1Co 10:1]], al.
of an author, originator, or archetype (= αἴτιος, ἀρχηγός, etc.; Pind., Plat., al.): [[r:JHN.8.41|Jhn 8:41-44]], [[r:ROM.4.11|Rom 4:11, 12]] 16.

as a title of respect or honour, used of seniors, teachers and others in a position of responsible authority ([[r:JDG.17.10|Jdg 17:10]], [[r:2SA.2.12|2Ki 2:12]], [[r:PRO.1.8|Pro 1:8]], al.): [[r:MAT.23.9|Mat 23:9]] [[r:ACT.7.2|Act 7:2 22:1]], [[r:1JN.2.13|1Jn 2:13]].
Of God (as in cl. of Zeus) as Father;

of all sentient beings: [[r:EPH.3.14|Eph 3:14, 15]] [[r:HEB.12.9|Heb 12:9]]; (with) of men, esp. those in covenant relation with Him (freq in OT and later Jewish lit.; see Dalman, Words, 184ff.): [[r:MAT.6.4|Mat 6:4]], [[r:LUK.6.36|Luk 6:36]], [[r:JHN.4.21|Jhn 4:21]], [[r:JAS.3.9|Jas 3:9]], al.; ὁ π. ὁ ἐν (τ.) οὐρανοῖς, [[r:MAT.5.16|Mat 5:16]], [[r:MRK.11.25|Mrk 11:25]]; ὁ π. ὁ οὐράνιος, [[r:MAT.6.14|Mat 6:14 15:13]]; esp. in the Epp., of Christians: [[r:ROM.8.15|Rom 8:15]], [[r:2CO.6.18|2Co 6:18]], [[r:GAL.4.6|Gal 4:6]], [[r:EPH.2.18|Eph 2:18 4:6]], [[r:1JN.2.1|1Jn 2:1]]; with genitive qual., τ. οἰκτιρμῶν, [[r:2CO.1.3|2Co 1:3]]; τ. δοξῆς, [[r:EPH.1.17|Eph 1:17]];

G3985.strongs: to test (objectively), i.e. endeavor, scrutinize, entice, discipline
G3985.kjv: assay, examine, go about, prove, tempt(-er), try
senses: πειράζω poët. and late prose form of πειράω, which see,
to try, attempt (Luc., Polyb., with inf. (see M, Pr., 205; B1., § 69, 4), [[r:ACT.9.26|Act 9:26 16:7 24:6]].
In LXX and NT, like Heb. נָסָה, with accusative of person(s), to test, try, prove;

in a bad sense (Apoll. Rhod., 3, 10): of the attempts made to ensnare Jesus in his speech, [[r:MAT.16.1|Mat 16:1 19:3 22:18, 35]] [[r:MRK.8.11|Mrk 8:11 10:2 12:15]], [[r:LUK.11.16|Luk 11:16]], [[r:JHN.8.6|Jhn 8:6]]; of temptation to sin, to tempt, [[r:JAS.1.13|Jas 1:13-14]] (see Hort, in l), [[r:GAL.6.1|Gal 6:1]], [[r:REV.2.10|Rev 2:10]]; esp. of temptations of the devil, [[r:MAT.4.1|Mat 4:1]], 3 [[r:MRK.1.13|Mrk 1:13]], [[r:LUK.4.2|Luk 4:2]], [[r:1CO.7.5|1Co 7:5]], [[r:1TH.3.5|1Th 3:5]]; ὁ πειράζων, the tempter, [[r:MAT.4.3|Mat 4:3]], [[r:1TH.3.5|1Th 3:5]]; (with) in bad sense also ([[r:EXO.17.2|Exo 17:2]], 7, [[r:NUM.14.22|Num 14:22]], al.), of distrustful testing, trying or challenging of God: [[r:ACT.15.10|Act 15:10]], [[r:1CO.10.9|1Co 10:9]] (WH, mg., ἐξεπείρασαν), [[r:HEB.3.9|Heb 3:9]]; τ. πνεῦμα Κυρίου, [[r:ACT.5.9|Act 5:9]] (of. ἐκ-πειράζω).† SYN.: δοκιμάζω, q.v (AS)

G3983.root: from the same as [[w:G3993]] (through the idea of pinching toil
G3983.strongs: "pine"); to famish (absolutely or comparatively); figuratively, to crave

G3996.strongs: to grieve (the feeling or the act)
senses: intrans.: [[r:MAT.5.4|Mat 5:4]] (5) [[r:MAT.9.15|Mat 9:15]], [[r:1CO.5.2|1Co 5:2]]; π. καὶ κλαίειν, [[r:MAT.16.10|Mat 16:10]], [[r:LUK.6.25|Luk 6:25]], [[r:JAS.4.9|Jas 4:9]], [[r:REV.18.15|Rev 18:15, 19]]; before ἐπί, with accusative, [[r:REV.18.11|Rev 18:11]];

G3928.strongs: to come near or aside, i.e. to approach (arrive), go by (or away), (figuratively) perish or neglect, (causative) avert
G3928.kjv: come (forth), go, pass (away, by, over), past, transgress
senses: of persons: absol., [[r:LUK.18.37|Luk 18:37]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:MRK.6.48|Mrk 6:48]]; with accusative lot., [[r:ACT.16.8|Act 16:8]]; before διά, with genitive, [[r:MAT.8.28|Mat 8:28]];

of things : τ. ποτήριον, [[r:MAT.26.39|Mat 26:39]] (ἀπ᾽ ἐμοῦ), [[r:MAT.26.42|Mat 26:42]]; of time, [[r:MAT.14.15|Mat 14:15]], [[r:MRK.14.35|Mrk 14:35]], [[r:ACT.27.9|Act 27:9]], [[r:1PE.4.3|1Pe 4:3]]. Metaphorical,
to pass by, neglect, disregard: with accusative of thing(s), [[r:LUK.11.42|Luk 11:42 15:29]].
to come to, arrive: [[r:LUK.12.37|Luk 12:37 17:7]], [[r:ACT.24.7|Act 24:7]], R, mg. (cf. ἀντι-παρέρχομαι).† SYN.: παραβαίνω (AS)
as adv., besides, in addition: τὰ π. (sc. γινόμενα), [[r:2CO.11.28|2Co 11:28.]]
As prep. with genitive, except: [[r:MAT.5.32|Mat 5:32 19:9]] (WH, mg., R, mg.), [[r:ACT.26.29|Act 26:29.]]† (AS)

G3986.strongs: a putting to proof (by experiment (of good), experience (of evil), solicitation, discipline or provocation); by implication, adversity
senses: a trial, of ethical purpose and effect, whether good or evil (see Hort on [[r:JAS.1.13|Jas 1:13]])

of trial regarded as leading to sin, temptation: [[r:LUK.8.13|Luk 8:13]], [[r:1CO.10.13|1Co 10:13]], [[r:1TI.6.9|1Ti 6:9]]; of the temptation of Jesus by the devil, [[r:LUK.4.13|Luk 4:13]]; εἰσφέρειν (ἔρχεσθαι, εἰσέρχ-) εἰς π., [[r:MAT.6.13|Mat 6:13 26:41]], [[r:MRK.14.38|Mrk 14:38]], [[r:LUK.11.4|Luk 11:4 22:40, 46]]; (with) of the testing or challenge of God by man (see: πειράζω, 3, with): [[r:HEB.3.8|Heb 3:8]] (LXX: [[r:PSA.95.9|Psa 95:9]], where κατα τ. ἡμέραν πειρασμοῦ = מַסָּה the day of Massah).† SYN.: δοκίμιον (AS)

G3900.strongs: a side-slip (lapse or deviation), i.e. (unintentional) error or (wilful) transgression

G3975.strongs: to thicken, i.e. (by implication) to fatten (figuratively, stupefy or render callous)
senses: (παχύς, thick) to thicken, fatten; pass., to grow fat. Metaphorical, to make dull or stupid (τ. ψυχάς, Rut.); pass., to wax gross: ἡ καρδία„ [[r:MAT.13.15|Mat 13:15]], [[r:ACT.28.27|Act 28:27]]" (LXX).† (AS)

G3908.strongs: to place alongside, i.e. present (food, truth); by implication, to deposit (as a trust or for protection)
G3908.kjv: allege, commend, commit (the keeping of), put forth, set before
senses: Act., to place beside, set before, with accusative and dative: of food, [[r:MRK.6.41|Mrk 6:41 8:6-7]], [[r:LUK.9.16|Luk 9:16 11:6]]; τράπεζαν, [[r:ACT.16.34|Act 16:34]]; pass. ptcp., [[r:LUK.10.8|Luk 10:8]], [[r:1CO.10.27|1Co 10:27]]; metaphorically, of teaching, παραβολήν, [[r:MAT.13.24|Mat 13:24, 31]].
to have set before one (Hom., Thuc., Xen., al.).

to deposit with another, give in charge or commit to (Hdt., Xen., Polyb., al.): with accusative and dative, [[r:LUK.12.48|Luk 12:48 23:46]], [[r:ACT.14.23|Act 14:23 20:32]], [[r:1TI.1.18|1Ti 1:18]], [[r:2TI.2.2|2Ti 2:2]], [[r:1PE.4.19|1Pe 4:19]].
to bring forward, quote as evidence: before ὅτι, [[r:ACT.17.3|Act 17:3]] (see Page, in l).† (AS)

G3968.strongs: a father-land, i.e. native town; (figuratively) heavenly home
senses: (πατήρ), prop. poët. fern. of πάτριος, of one's fathers; as subst., ἡ π. = πάτρα, fatherland, country, home, native place: [[r:ACT.18.27|Act 18:27]], WH, mg., [[r:HEB.11.14|Heb 11:14]]; of one's own town, [[r:MAT.13.54|Mat 13:54, 57]], [[r:MRK.6.1|Mrk 6:1]], 4, [[r:LUK.4.23|Luk 4:23-24]], [[r:JHN.4.44|Jhn 4:44]].† (AS)

G3979.root: dative case feminine of a derivative of [[w:G4228]] (as adverb)
senses: Opp. to going by sea, by land: [[r:MAT.14.13|Mat 14:13]] (WH, mg., R, mg.).
As adv., πεζῇ (sc. ὁδῷ), on foot or by land: Mt 1413 (WH, txt.), [[r:MRK.6.33|Mrk 6:33.]]† (AS)

G3958.strongs: to experience a sensation or impression (usually painful)
senses: πάσχω to suffer, be acted on, as opposite to acting, often limited by a word expressive of good or evil;

of misfortunes (most frequently without any limiting word): absol., [[r:LUK.22.15|Luk 22:15 24:46]], [[r:ACT.1.3|Act 1:3 3:18 17:3]], [[r:1CO.12.26|1Co 12:26]], [[r:HEB.2.18|Heb 2:18 9:26 13:12]], [[r:1PE.2.19|1Pe 2:19-20 2:23 3:17 4:15 4:19]]; before ὑπό, with genitive, [[r:MAT.17.12|Mat 17:12]]; ὑπέρ, [[r:ACT.9.16|Act 9:16]], [[r:PHP.1.20|Php 1:20]], [[r:2TH.1.5|2Th 1:5]], [[r:1PE.2.21|1Pe 2:21]]; with dative ref., [[r:1PE.4.1|1Pe 4:1]]; περί, with genitive (before ὑπέρ), [[r:1PE.3.18|1Pe 3:18]]; διά, with accusative, [[r:1PE.3.14|1Pe 3:14]]; ὀλίγον (a little while), [[r:1PE.5.10|1Pe 5:10]]; with accusative, [[r:MAT.27.19|Mat 27:19]], [[r:MRK.9.12|Mrk 9:12]], [[r:LUK.13.2|Luk 13:2 24:26]], [[r:ACT.28.5|Act 28:5]], [[r:2TI.1.12|2Ti 1:12]], [[r:HEB.5.8|Heb 5:8]], [[r:REV.2.10|Rev 2:10]]; παθήματα, [[r:2CO.1.6|2Co 1:6]]; ταῦτα, [[r:GAL.3.4|Gal 3:4]] (EV; cf. Lft., in l, but see infr.); accusative before ἀπό, [[r:MAT.16.21|Mat 16:21]], [[r:LUK.9.22|Luk 9:22 17:25]]; ὑπό, [[r:MRK.5.26|Mrk 5:26]], [[r:1TH.2.14|1Th 2:14]];

of pleasant experiences (but always with qualifying word, εὖ or accusative of thing(s)): [[r:GAL.3.4|Gal 3:4]] (cf. Grimm-Thayer, see word; Interp. Corn., in l, but see supr.) (cf. προ-, συν-πάσχω).† (AS)

G3989.strongs: deep or open sea, i.e. the main
senses: the deep sea, the deep, the sea: [[r:ACT.27.5|Act 27:5]]; τὸ π. τῆς θαλάσσης, [[r:MAT.18.6|Mat 18:6]] SYN.: θαλάσσα (which see); and cf. ἄβυσσος (AS)

G3916.strongs: at the thing itself, i.e. instantly
senses: παραχρῆμα adv. (= παρὰ τὸ χρῆμα), on the spot, forthwith, instantly: [[r:MAT.21.19|Mat 21:19-20]], [[r:LUK.1.64|Luk 1:64 4:39 5:25 8:44, 47 8:55 13:13 18:43 19:11 22:60]], [[r:ACT.3.7|Act 3:7 5:10 12:23 13:11 16:26, 33]] (on the usage in Mt, Lk, see Dalman, Words, 28 f.).† (AS)
In Comic poets and late prose, the dish itself on which the dainties are served: [[r:MAT.23.25|Mat 23:25-26]] (In this sense it is condemned by the Atticists; see Rutherford, NPhr., 265 f.)† (AS)

G3952.strongs: a being near, i.e. advent (often, return; specially, of Christ to punish Jerusalem, or finally the wicked); (by implication) physically, aspect
senses: usually in cl., a being present, presence: [[r:1CO.16.17|1Co 16:17]], [[r:2CO.10.10|2Co 10:10]]; opposite to ἀπουσία, [[r:PHP.2.12|Php 2:12]] (cf. [[r:2MA.15.21|2Ma 15:21]]).

a coming, arrival, advent (Soph., Eur., Thuc., al., see LS, see word; so Jth, l.with, [[r:2MA.8.12|2Ma 8:12]]): [[r:2CO.7.6|2Co 7:6-7]], [[r:PHP.1.26|Php 1:26]], [[r:2TH.2.9|2Th 2:9]]; in late writers (see M, Th., 145 ff.; MM, xix; LAE, 372 ff.) as technical term for the visit of a king; hence, in NT, specif. of the Advent or Parousia of Christ: [[r:MAT.24.3|Mat 24:3, 27 24:37, 39]], [[r:1CO.15.23|1Co 15:23]], [[r:1TH.2.19|1Th 2:19 3:13 4:15 5:23]], [[r:2TH.2.1|2Th 2:1 2:8]], [[r:JAS.5.7|Jas 5:7-8]], [[r:2PE.1.16|2Pe 1:16 3:4 3:12]], [[r:1JN.2.28|1Jn 2:28]].† (AS)

G3957.strongs: the Passover (the meal, the day, the festival or the special sacrifices connected with it)
senses: the paschal supper: ἑτοιμάζειν τὸ π., [[r:MAT.26.19|Mat 26:19]], [[r:MRK.14.16|Mrk 14:16]], [[r:LUK.22.8|Luk 22:8, 13]]; ποιεῖν τό π., [[r:MAT.26.18|Mat 26:18]];

G3930.strongs: to hold near, i.e. present, afford, exhibit, furnish occasion
G3930.kjv: bring, do, give, keep, minister, offer, shew, + trouble
senses: to furnish, provide, supply; with ref. to incorporeal things, to afford, show, give, cause: with accusative, [[r:ACT.22.2|Act 22:2]], [[r:1TI.1.4|1Ti 1:4]]; with accusative and dative, [[r:MAT.26.10|Mat 26:10]], [[r:MRK.14.6|Mrk 14:6]], [[r:LUK.11.7|Luk 11:7 18:5]], [[r:ACT.16.16|Act 16:16 17:31 28:2]], [[r:GAL.6.17|Gal 6:17]], [[r:1TI.6.17|1Ti 6:17]].
to present, offer: with accusative and dative, [[r:LUK.6.29|Luk 6:29]]; with prop. reflex. and accusative pred., to show or present oneself (see infr., and cf. B1., § 55, 1).
to supply, furnish or display of one's own part: with accusative and dative, [[r:LUK.7.4|Luk 7:4]], [[r:ACT.19.24|Act 19:24]], [[r:COL.4.1|Col 4:1]].
In late writers, with prop. reflex. and accusative pred. (= act. ut supr.), to show or present oneself (Xen., FlJ, al.; cf. M, Pr., 248; Deiss., BS, 254): [[r:TIT.2.7|Tit 2:7.]]† (AS)

G3960.strongs: to knock (gently or with a weapon or fatally)
senses: in Hom., intrans., to beat (of the heart).

Trans. = πλήσσω, to strike, smite: absol., ἐν μαχαίρᾳ, [[r:LUK.22.49|Luk 22:49]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.26.51|Mat 26:51]], [[r:LUK.22.50|Luk 22:50]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:ACT.12.7|Act 12:7]]; of a deadly blow, [[r:MAT.26.31|Mat 26:31]], [[r:MRK.14.27|Mrk 14:27]], [[r:ACT.7.24|Act 7:24]]. Metaphorical, of disease: [[r:ACT.12.23|Act 12:23]], [[r:REV.11.6|Rev 11:6 19:15]].† (AS)

G3918.strongs: to be near, i.e. at hand; neuter present participle (singular) time being, or (plural) property
G3918.kjv: come, X have, be here, + lack, (be here) present
senses: to be by, at hand or present;

of persons: [[r:REV.17.8|Rev 17:8]]; παρών (opposite to ἀπών), [[r:1CO.5.3|1Co 5:3]], [[r:2CO.10.2|2Co 10:2 10:11 13:2 13:10]]; before ἐπί with genitive, [[r:ACT.24.19|Act 24:19]]; ἐνώπιον, [[r:ACT.10.33|Act 10:33]]; ἐνθάδε, [[r:ACT.17.6|Act 17:6]]; πρός, with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.12.20|Act 12:20]], [[r:2CO.11.8|2Co 11:8]], [[r:GAL.4.18|Gal 4:18, 20]];
of things : of time, ὁ καιρός, [[r:JHN.7.6|Jhn 7:6]]; τ. παρόν, [[r:HEB.12.11|Heb 12:11]]; ἡ ἀλήθεια, [[r:2PE.1.12|2Pe 1:12]]; ταῦτα, [[r:2PE.1.9|2Pe 1:9]]; τ. παρόντα, [[r:HEB.13.5|Heb 13:5.]]

to have come or arrived (Hdt., Thuc., al.; see Field, Notes, 65): [[r:LUK.13.1|Luk 13:1]], [[r:JHN.11.28|Jhn 11:28]], [[r:ACT.10.21|Act 10:21]]; before εἰς, [[r:COL.1.6|Col 1:6]]; before ἐπί, with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.26.50|Mat 26:50]] (cf. συν-πάρειμι).† (AS)

G3936.strongs: to stand beside, i.e. (transitively) to exhibit, proffer, (specially), recommend, (figuratively) substantiate; or (intransitively) to be at hand (or ready), aid
G3936.kjv: assist, bring before, command, commend, give presently, present, prove, provide, shew, stand (before, by, here, up, with), yield
senses: Transitive verb. in present tense., imperfect., future tense., 1 aorist.;

to place beside, present, provide: with accusative, [[r:ACT.9.41|Act 9:41 23:24]], [[r:2CO.4.14|2Co 4:14]], [[r:COL.1.28|Col 1:28]]; with accusative and dative, [[r:MAT.26.53|Mat 26:53]], [[r:LUK.2.22|Luk 2:22]], [[r:ACT.1.3|Act 1:3 23:33]], [[r:1CO.8.8|1Co 8:8]]; before accusative pred., [[r:ROM.6.13|Rom 6:13, 16]] (late pres., παριστάνετε), [[r:ROM.6.19|Rom 6:19 12:1]], [[r:2CO.11.2|2Co 11:2]], [[r:EPH.5.27|Eph 5:27]], [[r:COL.1.22|Col 1:22]], [[r:2TI.2.15|2Ti 2:15]].
to present to the mind (cl.): by argument, to prove (Xen., FlJ, al.), with accusative, [[r:ACT.24.13|Act 24:13.]]
to stand by or beside one : with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.1.10|Act 1:10 9:39 23:2 27:23]]; ptcp., [[r:MRK.14.47|Mrk 14:47, 69-70 15:35, 39]] [[r:JHN.18.22|Jhn 18:22 19:26]].
to appear: with nom. pred., before ἐνώπιον, [[r:ACT.4.10|Act 4:10]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.27.24|Act 27:24]]; so fut. mid. (of. LS, see word, B, ii, 2), [[r:ROM.14.10|Rom 14:10.]]

to be at hand, be present, have come: [[r:ACT.4.26|Act 4:26]] (LXX); of servants in attendance, ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, [[r:LUK.1.19|Luk 1:19]]; absol., οἱ παρεστῶτες, [[r:LUK.19.24|Luk 19:24]]; before αὐτῷ, [[r:ACT.23.2|Act 23:2]], 4; of time, [[r:MRK.4.29|Mrk 4:29]]
to stand by for help or defence (Hom., Dem., Xen., al.): with dative of person(s), [[r:ROM.16.2|Rom 16:2]], [[r:2TI.4.17|2Ti 4:17]].† (AS)

G3982.strongs: to convince (by argument, true or false); by analogy, to pacify or conciliate (by other fair means); reflexively or passively, to assent (to evidence or authority), to rely (by inward certainty)
G3982.kjv: agree, assure, believe, have confidence, be (wax) conflent, make friend, obey, persuade, trust, yield
senses: trans., to apply persuasion ("conative" in pres.; see M, Pr., 147), to prevail upon or win over, persuade: absol., [[r:MAT.28.14|Mat 28:14]], [[r:ACT.19.26|Act 19:26]]; before περί, with genitive of thing(s), [[r:ACT.19.8|Act 19:8]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.12.20|Act 12:20 14:19 18:4]], [[r:2CO.5.11|2Co 5:11]], [[r:GAL.1.10|Gal 1:10]]; τ. καρδίας ἡμῶν, [[r:1JN.3.19|1Jn 3:19]]; with accusative before περί, [[r:ACT.28.23|Act 28:23]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:ACT.13.43|Act 13:43 26:28]] (see Field, Notes, 141 ff.); with accusative before ἵνα (Plut.), [[r:MAT.27.20|Mat 27:20.]]

Intrans., 2 pf. πέποιθα with Pres. sense (see M, Pr., 147, 154; Bl., § 59, 2): to trust, be confident, have confidence: with accusative and inf., [[r:ROM.2.19|Rom 2:19]]; with accusative ref. (see Ellic., in l): [[r:PHP.1.6|Php 1:6, 25]]; with dative, [[r:PHP.1.14|Php 1:14]], Phm 21; ἑαυτῷ, with inf., [[r:2CO.10.7|2Co 10:7]]; before ἐν, [[r:PHP.3.3|Php 3:3-4]]; ἐν κυρίῳ ὅτι, [[r:PHP.2.24|Php 2:24]]; ἐπί, with dative, [[r:MAT.27.43|Mat 27:43]] (WH, mg.), [[r:MRK.10.24|Mrk 10:24]] (T, WH, R, mg., om.), [[r:LUK.11.22|Luk 11:22 18:9]], [[r:2CO.1.9|2Co 1:9]], [[r:HEB.2.13|Heb 2:13]]; ἐπί, with accusative, [[r:MAT.27.43|Mat 27:43]] (with dative, WH, mg.); id. before ὅτι, [[r:2CO.2.3|2Co 2:3]], [[r:2TH.3.4|2Th 3:4]] (see Lft., Notes, 127); εἰς, with accusative of person(s) before ὅτι, [[r:GAL.5.10|Gal 5:10.]] (ii) Pass. and mid.;

to be persuaded, believe (see M, Pr., 158): absol., [[r:LUK.16.31|Luk 16:31]], [[r:ACT.17.4|Act 17:4 21:14]], [[r:HEB.13.18|Heb 13:18]]; with dative, [[r:ACT.28.24|Act 28:24]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:ACT.26.26|Act 26:26]]; so also pf., πέπεισμαι, πεπεισμένος εἰμί: with accusative ref. before περί, [[r:HEB.6.9|Heb 6:9]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:LUK.20.6|Luk 20:6]]; ὅτι, [[r:ROM.8.38|Rom 8:38]], [[r:2TI.1.5|2Ti 1:5 1:12]]; id. with ἐν κυρίῳ, [[r:ROM.14.14|Rom 14:14]]; περί, with genitive before ὅτι, [[r:ROM.15.14|Rom 15:14.]]

to listen to, obey: with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.5.36|Act 5:36-37, 40 23:21 27:11]], [[r:ROM.2.8|Rom 2:8]], [[r:GAL.5.7|Gal 5:7]], [[r:HEB.13.17|Heb 13:17]], [[r:JAS.3.3|Jas 3:3]] (cf. ἀνα-πείθω).† Πειθώ, -οῦς, ἡ
per­suasion: ἐν πειθοῖ (so Orig., Eus. and some cursives in [[r:1CO.2.4|1Co 2:4]] for πειθός, which see).† (AS)

In Jewish usage, the day of preparation for a Sabbath or a feast (= προσάββατον, which see): [[r:MAT.27.62|Mat 27:62]], [[r:MRK.15.42|Mrk 15:42]], [[r:LUK.23.54|Luk 23:54]], [[r:JHN.19.31|Jhn 19:31]]; with genitive, τοῦ πάσχα, [[r:JHN.19.14|Jhn 19:14]]; τ. Ἰoυδαίων, [[r:JHN.19.42|Jhn 19:42]] (it is the name for Friday in MGr.).† (AS)

G3906.strongs: to inspect alongside, i.e. note insidiously or scrupulously
senses: to watch closely, observe narrowly: so mid., τ. πύλας, [[r:ACT.9.24|Act 9:24]]; with evil intent, [[r:MRK.3.2|Mrk 3:2]], [[r:LUK.20.20|Luk 20:20]] (absol., see Field, Notes, 74); so mid., [[r:LUK.6.7|Luk 6:7 14:1]].
to observe scrupulously (of days and seasons; cf. [[r:EXO.12.42|Exo 12:42]], Sm.): mid., [[r:GAL.4.10|Gal 4:10.]]† (AS)

G3954.strongs: all out-spokenness, i.e. frankness, bluntness, publicity; by implication, assurance
G3954.kjv: bold (X -ly, -ness, -ness of speech), confidence, X freely, X openly, X plainly(-ness)
senses: freedom of speech, plainness, openness, freedom in speaking (Eur., Plat., al.): [[r:ACT.4.13|Act 4:13]], [[r:2CO.3.12|2Co 3:12]]; παρρησίᾳ, adverbially, freely, openly, plainly, [[r:MRK.8.32|Mrk 8:32]], [[r:JHN.7.13|Jhn 7:13, 26 10:24 11:14 16:29 18:20]]; opposite to ἐν παροιμίαις, [[r:JHN.16.25|Jhn 16:25]]; ἐν π., [[r:EPH.6.19|Eph 6:19]]; μετὰ π., [[r:ACT.2.29|Act 2:29 4:29, 31 28:31]]

In LXX ([[r:1MA.4.18|1Ma 4:18]], [[r:WIS.5.1|Wis 5:1]], al.), FlJ, and NT, also (from the absence of fear which accompanies freedom of speech), confidence, boldness: [[r:2CO.7.4|2Co 7:4]], [[r:PHP.1.20|Php 1:20]], [[r:1TI.3.13|1Ti 3:13]]; ἔχειν π., [[r:EPH.3.12|Eph 3:12]], Phm 8, [[r:HEB.3.6|Heb 3:6 10:19, 35]], [[r:1JN.2.28|1Jn 2:28]] [[r:JHN.3.21|Jn 3:21]] [[r:JHN.4.17|Jn 4:17]] [[r:JHN.5.14|Jn 5:14]]; μετὰ π., He 416; ἐν π., [[r:COL.2.15|Col 2:15]]; id. (as בפרהסיא in Rabbinic lit.; see Westc., Jo., i, 262), in public, [[r:JHN.7.4|Jhn 7:4]] and (without ἐν) [[r:JHN.11.54|Jhn 11:54.]]† (AS)

G3911.strongs: to bear along or aside, i.e. carry off (literally or figuratively); by implication, to avert
senses: to bring to, set before, esp. of food (Hdt., al.).

to take or carry away: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, [[r:MRK.14.36|Mrk 14:36]], [[r:LUK.22.42|Luk 22:42]]; pass., before ὑπό, Ju 12; metaphorically, pass., with dative, [[r:HEB.13.9|Heb 13:9.]]† (AS)

G3965.root: as if feminine of a derivative of [[w:G3962]]
G3965.strongs: paternal descent, i.e. (concretely) a group of families or a whole race (nation)
senses: = πάτρα (more common in cl.), a family or tribe (so sometimes in Hdt., in LXX of related people, in a sense narrower than φυλή and wider than οἶκος; see [[r:EXO.12.3|Exo 12:3]], [[r:NUM.32.28|Num 32:28]]): [[r:LUK.2.4|Luk 2:4]]; in a wider sense ([[r:1CH.16.28|1Ch 16:28]], [[r:PSA.22.27|Psa 22:27]]), [[r:ACT.3.25|Act 3:25]]" (LXX) [[r:EPH.3.15|Eph 3:15.]]† (AS)

G3973.strongs: to stop (transitively or intransitively), i.e. restrain, quit, desist, come to an end
senses: παύω to make to cease, restrain, hinder: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό [[r:1PE.3.10|1Pe 3:10]] (LXX). Mid., to cease, leave off: [[r:LUK.8.24|Luk 8:24 11:1]], [[r:ACT.20.1|Act 20:1]], [[r:1CO.13.8|1Co 13:8]]; with ptcp., [[r:LUK.5.4|Luk 5:4]], [[r:ACT.5.42|Act 5:42 6:13 13:10 20:31 21:32]], [[r:EPH.1.16|Eph 1:16]], [[r:COL.1.9|Col 1:9]], [[r:HEB.10.2|Heb 10:2]]; with genitive, ἀμαρτίας, [[r:1PE.4.1|1Pe 4:1]] (WH, mg., R, txt.); with dative, ib. (WH, txt., R, mg.).† (AS)

G3977.root: from a derivative of [[w:G4228]] (meaning the ground)

G3961.root: from a derivative probably of [[w:G3817]] (meaning a "path")
senses: intrans., to tread, walk: before ἐπάνω ὄφεων κ.τ.λ. (figuratively), [[r:LUK.10.19|Luk 10:19]] (cf. [[r:PSA.91.13|Psa 91:13]]).

Trans., to tread on, trample: τ. ληνόν, [[r:REV.14.20|Rev 14:20 19:15]] (cf. [[r:JDG.9.27|Jdg 9:27]], [[r:LAM.1.15|La 1:15]], al.); of the desecration of Jerusalem by its enemies, [[r:LUK.21.24|Luk 21:24]], [[r:REV.11.2|Rev 11:2]] (cf. κατα-, περι-, ἐν-περι-πατέω).† (AS)
to pass by or over, let alone, disregard: [[r:LUK.11.42|Luk 11:42.]]
to relax, loosen; pass., to be relaxed, weakened, exhausted: παρειμένας χεῖρας, [[r:HEB.12.12|Heb 12:12]] (LXX ἀνειμ-).† (AS)

G3925.strongs: a throwing in beside (juxtaposition), i.e. (specially), battle-array, encampment or barracks (tower Antonia)
senses: In the Macedonian dialect (Rutherford, NPhr., 473), as a military term;
an army in battle array: [[r:HEB.11.34|Heb 11:34]] (cf. [[r:EXO.14.19|Exo 14:19-20]], [[r:JDG.4.16|Jdg 4:16]], al.; frequently in Polyb.);

a camp ([[r:EXO.29.14|Exo 29:14]], al.): [[r:HEB.13.11|Heb 13:11, 13]] [[r:REV.20.9|Rev 20:9]]; (with) barracks, soldiers' quarters: [[r:ACT.21.34|Act 21:34, 37 22:24 23:10, 16 23:32 28:16]] (WH, txt., R, om.).† παρ-εμ-βάλλω,
to put in beside or between, interpose.
In late writers (Polyb., al., LXX) as technical military term;
of soldiers, to draw up in line (frequently in [[r:1MA.2.32|1Ma 2:32]], al.);
of siege works, to cast up: with accusative and dative, χάρακά σοι, [[r:LUK.19.43|Luk 19:43.]]† (AS)
(πένομαι, see: πένης) chiefly in Comic poets and late prose (but Plato, Rep., 578 A), = πένης, needy, poor: [[r:LUK.21.2|Luk 21:2]] (for ex. in π., see MM, xix).† (AS)

G3939.strongs: to dwell near, i.e. reside as a foreigner
senses: παρ-οικέω, -ῶ in cl., to dwell beside (with accusative), among (with dative) or near by (absol.). In late writers, to dwell in a place as a πάροικος (which see) or stranger: [[r:LUK.24.18|Luk 24:18]], [[r:HEB.11.9|Heb 11:9]].† (AS)

G3942.root: from a compound of [[w:G3844]] and perhaps a derivative of [[w:G3633]]
G3942.strongs: apparently a state alongside of supposition, i.e. (concretely) an adage; specially, an enigmatical or fictitious illustration
senses: a wayside saying (Hesych.; see LS, see word), a byword, maxim, proverb: [[r:2PE.2.22|2Pe 2:22.]]
In NT, of figurative discourse (as מָשַׁל, [[r:ISA.14.4|Isa 14:4]], al.), a parable, allegory: [[r:JHN.10.6|Jhn 10:6 16:25, 29]] (see Abbott, Essays, 82 ff.).† SYN.: παραβολή, q.v (AS)

G3934.strongs: a Parthian, i.e. inhabitant of Parthia

G3980.strongs: to be persuaded by a ruler, i.e. (genitive case) to submit to authority; by analogy, to conform to advice
senses: (πείθομαι, ἀρχή) to obey one in authority, be obedient: [[r:TIT.3.1|Tit 3:1]]; with dative, [[r:ACT.27.21|Act 27:21]]; θεῷ, [[r:ACT.5.29|Act 5:29, 32]].† (AS)

G3937.root: probably by contraction for Παρμενίδης (a derivative of a compound of [[w:G3844]] and [[w:G3306]])

G3941.strongs: having a home near, i.e. (as noun) a by-dweller (alien resident)
senses: in cl. Attic, dwelling near, neighbouring; as subst., a neighbour.

In late writers (LXX, Philo) and in Iuser. (Deiss., BS, 227 f.; Kennedy, Sources, 102), foreign, alien; as subst., an alien, a sojourner: [[r:ACT.7.6|Act 7:6]] (LXX), [[r:ACT.7.29|Act 7:29]]; metapb., ξένοι καὶ π. (opposite to συμπολίτης), [[r:EPH.2.19|Eph 2:19]]; π. καὶ παρεπιδήμους (which see), [[r:1PE.2.11|1Pe 2:11]] (see Lft. on Clem. Rom., 1 Co., § 1).† (AS)

G3955.strongs: to be frank in utterance, or confident in spirit and demeanor
senses: (παρρησία), to speak freely or boldly, be bold in speech: [[r:ACT.9.27|Act 9:27-28 13:46 14:3 18:26 19:8 26:26]], [[r:EPH.6.20|Eph 6:20]], [[r:1TH.2.2|1Th 2:2]].† (AS)

G3903.strongs: to furnish aside, i.e. get ready
senses: παρα-σκευάζω to prepare, make ready: absol. (sc. τ. δεῖπνον, etc.; of. Hdt., ix, 82, [[r:2MA.2.27|2Ma 2:27]]), [[r:ACT.10.10|Act 10:10]]; mid., to prepare, make preparations: [[r:1CO.14.8|1Co 14:8]] (cf. Je, l.with); pass., [[r:2CO.9.2|2Co 9:2-3.]]† (AS)

G3972.strongs: (little; but remotely from a derivative of, meaning the same); Paulus, the name of a Roman and of an apostle
senses: the Apostle Paul (cf. Σαῦλος): [[r:ACT.13.9|Act 13:9]], and frequently throughout Ac., [[r:ROM.1.1|Rom 1:1]], [[r:1CO.1.1|1Co 1:1]], al., [[r:2PE.3.15|2Pe 3:15]]. (AS)

G3951.strongs: to urge along, i.e. stimulate (to hostility)
senses: παρ-οτρύνω to urge on, stir up: with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.13.50|Act 13:50]] (find., Hipp., and late writers).† (AS)

G3944.strongs: to escape along, i.e. be gone
senses: παρ-οίχομαι to have passed by; of time, to be gone by: ἐν τ. παρῳχημέναις γενεαῖς, [[r:ACT.14.16|Act 14:16.]]† (AS)
παρ-εν-οχλέω, -ῶ (cf. ἐνοχλέω), to annoy concerning a matter (παρά): with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.15.19|Act 15:19.]]† (AS)

G3947.strongs: to sharpen alongside, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate
senses: primarily, but never so in cl., to sharpen (μάχαιραν, [[r:DEU.32.41|Deu 32:41]], שָׁנַן).

G3909.strongs: to chance near, i.e. fall in with
senses: παρα-τυγχάνω to happen to be near or present: [[r:ACT.17.17|Act 17:17.]]† (AS)

G3905.strongs: to extend along, i.e. prolong (in point of time)

G3978.strongs: to foot a journey, i.e. travel by land
senses: (πεζός) to travel on foot or by land: [[r:ACT.20.13|Act 20:13.]]† (AS)

G3959.strongs: Patara, a place in Asia Minor

senses: (πατήρ), of one's fathers, received from one's fathers: [[r:ACT.22.3|Act 22:3 24:14 28:17]].† (AS)
πειράω more commonly as depon., πειράομαι, to try, attempt: [[r:ACT.26.21|Act 26:21.]]† (AS)

G3914.strongs: to winter near, i.e. stay with over the rainy season
senses: παρα-χειμάζω to winter at a place: before εἰς, [[r:ACT.27.12|Act 27:12]]; ἐν, [[r:ACT.28.11|Act 28:11]]; πρὸς ὑμᾶς, [[r:1CO.16.6|1Co 16:6]]; ἐκεῖ, [[r:TIT.3.12|Tit 3:12.]]† (AS)

G3902.strongs: side-marked, i.e. labelled (with a badge (figure-head) of a ship)
senses: in cl., marked amiss, spurious, counterfeit. Later,
marked with a sign (LXX); as subst., a figure­head : [[r:ACT.28.11|Act 28:11]] (see MM, xix).† (AS)
prætermission, passing by (of debt or sin): [[r:ROM.3.25|Rom 3:25]]† SYN.: ἄφεσις, q.v (AS)

G3922.strongs: to come in alongside, i.e. supervene additionally or steathily
senses: to come in beside or by the way: [[r:ROM.5.20|Rom 5:20.]]
παρ-οργίζω (in cl., passive only), to provoke to anger: [[r:ROM.10.19|Rom 10:19]] (LXX), [[r:EPH.6.4|Eph 6:4.]]† (AS)

G3969.root: perhaps a contraction for Πατρόβιος (a compound of [[w:G3962]] and [[w:G0979]])

senses: πάρ-οδος, -ου, ἡ a passing or passage: ἐν π., in passing, [[r:1CO.16.7|1Co 16:7.]]† (AS)

G3910.strongs: at the very instant, i.e. momentary
senses: παρ-αυτίκα adv. (πάραυτα = παρ ̓ αὐτά, sc. τὰ πράγματα)
C. subst., to express brief duration (cf. ἡ π. λαμπρότης, Thuc., ii, 64), momentary, for a moment: [[r:2CO.4.17|2Co 4:17.]]† (AS)

G3993.root: from a primary πένω (to toil for daily subsistence)
senses: (πένομαι, to work for one's daily bread), one who works for his living, a labourer, a poor man: [[r:2CO.9.9|2Co 9:9.]]† SYN.: πτωχός, properly a beggar and implying deeper poverty than π. (see Tr., Syn., § xxxvi, Abbott, Essays, 78) (AS)
παρα-φρονέω (ιαρά, φρήν), to be beside oneself, be deranged: [[r:2CO.11.23|2Co 11:23.]]† (AS)
παρ-είσ-ακτος, -ον (παρεισάγω), brought in secretly (as spies or traitors): [[r:GAL.2.4|Gal 2:4.]]† (AS)

trans., to apply persuasion ("conative" in pres.; see M, Pr., 147), to prevail upon or win over, persuade: absol., [[r:MAT.28.14|Mat 28:14]], [[r:ACT.19.26|Act 19:26]]; before περί, with genitive of thing(s), [[r:ACT.19.8|Act 19:8]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.12.20|Act 12:20 14:19 18:4]], [[r:2CO.5.11|2Co 5:11]], [[r:GAL.1.10|Gal 1:10]]; τ. καρδίας ἡμῶν, [[r:1JN.3.19|1Jn 3:19]]; with accusative before περί, [[r:ACT.28.23|Act 28:23]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:ACT.13.43|Act 13:43 26:28]] (see Field, Notes, 141 ff.); with accusative before ἵνα (Plut.), [[r:MAT.27.20|Mat 27:20.]]

Intrans., 2 pf. πέποιθα with Pres. sense (see M, Pr., 147, 154; Bl., § 59, 2): to trust, be confident, have confidence: with accusative and inf., [[r:ROM.2.19|Rom 2:19]]; with accusative ref. (see Ellic., in l): [[r:PHP.1.6|Php 1:6, 25]]; with dative, [[r:PHP.1.14|Php 1:14]], Phm 21; ἑαυτῷ, with inf., [[r:2CO.10.7|2Co 10:7]]; before ἐν, [[r:PHP.3.3|Php 3:3-4]]; ἐν κυρίῳ ὅτι, [[r:PHP.2.24|Php 2:24]]; ἐπί, with dative, [[r:MAT.27.43|Mat 27:43]] (WH, mg.), [[r:MRK.10.24|Mrk 10:24]] (T, WH, R, mg., om.), [[r:LUK.11.22|Luk 11:22 18:9]], [[r:2CO.1.9|2Co 1:9]], [[r:HEB.2.13|Heb 2:13]]; ἐπί, with accusative, [[r:MAT.27.43|Mat 27:43]] (with dative, WH, mg.); id. before ὅτι, [[r:2CO.2.3|2Co 2:3]], [[r:2TH.3.4|2Th 3:4]] (see Lft., Notes, 127); εἰς, with accusative of person(s) before ὅτι, [[r:GAL.5.10|Gal 5:10.]] (ii) Pass. and mid.;

παρ-οργισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (παροργίζω), irritation ("distinguished from ὀργή as implying a less permanent state"; ICC, Eph., 140; and see Tr., Syn., § xxxvii): [[r:EPH.4.26|Eph 4:26.]]† (AS)

G3931.root: from a compound of [[w:G3844]] and a derivative of [[w:G0058]] (meaning to harangue an assembly)

G3964.root: from [[w:G3962]] and the same as the latter part of [[w:G3389]]
senses: πατρολῴας (-αλῴας, Rec.; in cl. -αλοίας, see Bl., § 3, 3; 6, 2, and cf. μητρολῴας), -ου, ὁ (πατήρ + ἀλοιάω, to smite),
a smiter of his father : ib. (R, mg.).† (AS)

G3943.strongs: staying near wine, i.e. tippling (a toper)
senses: πάρ-οινος, -ον = cl., παροινικός (παρά, οἶνος), given to wine, drunken: [[r:1TI.3.3|1Ti 3:3]], [[r:TIT.1.7|Tit 1:7]].† (AS)

G3901.strongs: to flow by, i.e. (figuratively) carelessly pass (miss)
senses: παρα-ρρέω to flow by, drift away, slip away: [[r:HEB.2.1|Heb 2:1.]]† (AS)

G3927.strongs: an alien alongside, i.e. a resident foreigner
senses: παρ-επί-δημος, -ον (see: ἐπιδημέω), sojourning in a strange place; as subst., ὁ π., a sojourner: of Christians, [[r:1PE.1.1|1Pe 1:1]]; ξένοι καὶ π., [[r:HEB.11.13|Heb 11:13]]; πάροικοι καὶ π., [[r:1PE.2.11|1Pe 2:11]] (see Deiss., BS, 149).† (AS)

G3984.root: from the base of [[w:G4008]] (through the idea of piercing)
senses: (πειράω), trial, experiment; π. λαμβάνειν, to make trial, have experience of: [[r:HEB.11.29|Heb 11:29, 36]] (for exx., see Field, Notes, 232 f.).† (AS)

G3970.root: from [[w:G3962]] and a derivative of [[w:G3860]] (in the sense of handing over or down)
senses: πατρο-παρά-δοτος, -ον (πατήρ, παραδίδωμι), handed down from one's fathers, inherited: [[r:1PE.1.18|1Pe 1:18]] (Diod., al.).† (AS)

G3923.strongs: to bear in alongside, i.e. introduce simultaneously
senses: παρ-εισ-φέρω to bring in or supply besides: σπουδὴν π. (late Gk. for cl. σ. ποιεῖσθαι; cf. Deiss., BS, 361), [[r:2PE.1.5|2Pe 1:5.]]† (AS)

G3919.strongs: to lead in aside, i.e. introduce surreptitiously
senses: to lead in by one's side, bring forward, introduce.
In late writers, to introduce or bring in secretly: [[r:2PE.2.1|2Pe 2:1.]]† (AS)

G3921.root: from [[w:G3844]] and a compound of [[w:G1519]] and [[w:G1416]]
G3921.strongs: to settle in alongside, i.e. lodge stealthily
senses: παρ-εισ-δύω (also -δύνω), to slip in secretly, steal in: παρεισεδύησαν (vulgar aor.; pass. for act., El., § 19, 2), Ju 4 (cf. also MM, xix).† (AS)

G3963.strongs: Patmus, an islet in the Mediterranean
senses: Patmos, an island in the Ægean Sea: [[r:REV.1.9|Rev 1:9.]]† (AS)

G3990.root: from a derivative of [[w:G4141]] (meaning an axe)
G3990.strongs: to chop off (the head), i.e. truncate
senses: (πέλεκυς, a battle-axe), to out off with an axe, esp. to behead: with accusative, [[r:REV.20.4|Rev 20:4]] (Polyb., al.).† (AS)
